rows.subject: global_analyst
rows.question: 2026年6月售出设备按型号看30天售后设备率。仅取已观察满30天的批次，含退款设备，同一台多次报修只记一台；返回型号、设备分母、售后设备分子和百分数。
rows.reason: exact group set and numeric multiset matched independent Python arithmetic
rows.sql: SELECT "dp"."product_name" AS "product_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "bod"."device_id") AS "devices", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "fst"."device_id" IS NULL THEN "bod"."device_id" END) AS "matched_devices", CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT "bod"."device_id") = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "fst"."device_id" IS NULL THEN "bod"."device_id" END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT "bod"."device_id"), 2) END AS "rate_percent" FROM "fact_order" AS "fo" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "foi" ON "fo"."order_id" = "foi"."order_id" JOIN "bridge_order_device" AS "bod" ON "foi"."item_id" = "bod"."item_id" JOIN "dim_device" AS "dd" ON "bod"."device_id" = "dd"."device_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "dp" ON "dd"."product_id" = "dp"."product_id" LEFT JOIN "fact_service_ticket" AS "fst" ON "bod"."device_id" = "fst"."device_id" AND "fst"."created_date" >= "fo"."paid_date" AND "fst"."created_date" <= "fo"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAY WHERE "fo"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE) AND "fo"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE) AND "fo"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-09-16' AS DATE) GROUP BY "dp"."product_name" ORDER BY "product_name" LIMIT 1001

rows.subject: global_analyst
rows.question: 2026年6月各固件版本的设备日离线率是多少？用online=0的设备日除总设备日，请返回版本名、设备日总数和百分数。
rows.sql: SELECT "df"."firmware_name" AS "firmware_name", COUNT(*) AS "total_device_days", SUM(CASE WHEN "fdd"."online" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "offline_device_days", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "fdd"."online" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS "offline_rate_percent" FROM "fact_device_day" AS "fdd" INNER JOIN "dim_firmware" AS "df" ON "fdd"."firmware_id" = "df"."firmware_id" WHERE "fdd"."event_date" >= CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE) AND "fdd"."event_date" <= CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY "df"."firmware_name" ORDER BY "firmware_name" LIMIT 1001
